narrative: 尺度、危险，或一个笑点在瞬间全部显现。原本亲密的时刻被削弱了，因为这个世界本来就是这么大——镜头只是把这个事实坦白出来。
这一猛拉本身就是笑点或恐怖感所在，而不是一次礼貌的揭示。如果你需要摄影机在家具间向后穿行，或者新揭示的空间必须以分层的方式从镜头前掠过，这就是错误的工具。
光学上的骤然抛开，并不等于一次撤退。
how: 锁定机身。让变焦保持居中，避免主体产生横向的拖影。
在一秒之内，从紧凑的构图猛然拉到预先构好的宽景，然后定住这个宽景。变化过程中出现放射状模糊，而不是手持晃动。
提示词要求突然的急拉变焦、环境瞬间“炸裂”般涌入画面，然后是锁定的宽景定格。
when: 用它来以震惊的方式揭示尺度，或削弱一个亲密时刻。具体场景：一个亲密的双人镜头，猛然拉开变成一个挤满目击者的停车场。
如果摄影机必须真实地离开主体，就不要使用这个手法。
vs: 急推变焦（Crash Zoom In）朝相反方向猛推进入细节。拉镜头（Pull Out）则是摄影机带着视差向后移动。
慢速变焦拉远（Slow Zoom Out）呈现同样的光学变宽效果，但没有那种冲击感。急拉变焦则是骤然抛开，然后定格。
examples_film: 《僵尸肖恩》（Shaun of the Dead）从面部猛然拉开到更宽的喜剧空间。《鬼玩人》（Evil Dead）用剧烈的光学变宽制造惊吓效果。
《热血警探》（Hot Fuzz）在两个方向上都运用了这一手法。要模仿的是那种“猛然一变、然后定格”的节奏，而不是具体的笑点内容。
mistakes: 常见的错误近亲是推轨后拉（Dolly Out），或是方向搞反的急推变焦（Crash Zoom In）。破绽在于前景发生滑动，或者画面变得更紧而不是更宽。
修正方法：机身锁定，预先构好宽景终点，猛然拉开，然后定格。

faq.q: 电影中的“急拉变焦”是什么？
faq.a: 这是焦距的极速减小，通常在摄影机静止的状态下，把一个紧凑的画面猛然抛开成一个宽景，然后定住这个宽景。

faq.q: 急拉变焦 与 拉镜头 的区别
faq.a: 拉镜头是摄影机后移，使空间随着视差逐渐打开。急拉变焦只是镜头变宽，机位本身从未改变。

faq.q: 什么时候该使用急拉变焦？
faq.a: 当你需要一个瞬间的尺度笑点、在特写面孔周围揭示出威胁，或制造强烈的反差削弱效果时使用。不要把它当作缓慢的退场方式。

faq.q: 如何为AI图像或视频撰写急拉变焦的提示词？
faq.a: 写出一秒以内的猛拉变焦、机身静止、环境瞬间全部显现，然后是锁定的宽景定格。排除物理上的后退。

narrative: Scale, danger, or a joke appears all at once. The close moment is undercut because the world was always that large; the lens simply confessed.
The snap is the comedy or the horror, not a polite reveal. It is the wrong tool when you need to walk backward through furniture, or when the newly revealed space must pass the camera in layers.
Optical dump is not a retreat.
how: Lock the body. Center the zoom so the subject does not smear sideways.
Snap from the tight composition to a pre-composed wide in under a second, then hold the wide. Radial blur during the change, not handheld bounce.
Prompt a sudden crash zoom out, environment exploding into view, then a locked wide hold.
when: Use it to shock-reveal scale or undercut a close moment. Concrete beat: an intimate two-shot snaps to a parking lot full of witnesses.
Do not use it when the camera must physically leave the subject.
vs: A Crash Zoom In punches the other way, into a detail. A Pull Out translates the camera backward with parallax.
A Slow Zoom Out discloses the same optical widening without the sting. Crash zoom out is the dump, then the hold.
examples_film: Shaun of the Dead snaps from faces into wider comic geography. Evil Dead uses violent optical widening as shock.
Hot Fuzz works the same family in both directions. Copy the snap-and-hold, not the gag content.
mistakes: The usual wrong cousin is a Dolly Out or a Crash Zoom In fired in the wrong direction. The tell is sliding foreground or a punch that gets tighter instead of wider.
The fix: locked body, pre-composed wide end, snap out, hold.

faq.q: What is Crash Zoom Out in film?
faq.a: It is a very fast decrease of focal length that throws a tight image into a wide one, usually from a still camera, then holds the wide.

faq.q: Crash Zoom Out vs Pull Out
faq.a: A pull out moves the camera away so space opens with parallax. A crash zoom out only widens the lens, so the station point never changes.

faq.q: When should I use Crash Zoom Out?
faq.a: When you need an instant scale joke, a threat revealed around a close face, or a hard undercut. Do not use it as a slow exit.

faq.q: How do I prompt Crash Zoom Out for AI image or video?
faq.a: Write snap zoom out in under a second, camera body still, environment appearing at once, then a locked wide hold. Ban physical retreat.
